mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_log (transaction_no, operation_id, original_log_id, account_id, type, amount, balance, source, service_key, price_version, description, request_id, request_hash, status) VALUES (#{transactionNo}, #{operationId}, #{originalLogId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balance}, #{source}, #{serviceKey}, #{priceVersion}, #{description}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{status})
